message.content:
**C♯ major** has a key signature of **seven sharps**:

| Sharp | Note |
|-------|------|
| F♯   | F♯ |
| C♯   | C♯ |
| G♯   | G♯ |
| D♯   | D♯ |
| A♯   | A♯ |
| E♯   | E♯ |
| B♯   | B♯ |

(These are the same pitches as the key of D♭ major, which uses five flats.)
